info.title: ParkSecure API
info.description:
REST API for the ParkSecure vehicle security platform.

**Authentication:** obtain a JWT via `POST /api/auth/login` and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

**Roles:** `super_admin`, `park_admin`, `facility_admin`, `security`, `vehicle_owner`. Staff with an assigned facility are automatically scoped to that facility; vehicle owners only see their own records.
